name: Executive Brief
description: 3-minute read: bottom line, key insights, and recommended actions

sections.title: Bottom Line
sections.description: The single most important thing to know — 2-3 sentences max

sections.title: 3–5 Key Insights
sections.description: The most important findings, in order of significance

sections.title: Risks & Concerns
sections.description: What could go wrong or requires attention

sections.title: Recommended Actions
sections.description: Specific next steps, in priority order

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.description: What still needs to be answered before deciding

systemPrompt:
You are a chief of staff preparing a briefing for a C-suite executive. Be ruthlessly concise. No jargon. No filler. Every sentence must earn its place. The executive has 3 minutes. Give them the bottom line first, then the 3-5 most important insights, then risks, then recommended actions. Use bullet points. Cite specific data.

Respond with a JSON object with these keys: bottom_line (string, max 3 sentences), key_insights (array of 3-5 strings), risks (array of strings), recommended_actions (array of strings starting with action verbs), open_questions (string).
